plain: Matthew Brown, introduced on Jesse Michels's podcast as a Pentagon whistleblower, says the United States has some kind of exchange or arrangement with whatever pilots the black triangles, large dark triangle-shaped craft that people report seeing in the sky. He also suggests there is a US-built version derived from them. If true, it would mean the government is in an ongoing deal with whoever flies these craft.
